title.narrative: Early lifesaving emergency Health services to communities projected to be most affected by El Nino induced riverine flooding in Jowhar.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-family:"gtInternational Medical Corps (IMC) is a US-registered independent affiliate organization of International Medical Corps UK (IMC UK), with which IMC UK shares the same name and charitable objectives and mission. IMC UK and IMC work together to deliver assistance programs in an accountable and effective manner to pursue their commonly held charitable objectives. IMC UK will engage IMC to implement its programs in the field, with IMC UK oversight, according to the terms and conditions of the agreement that results from this proposal and the terms of the party’s administrative service agreement. Together with IMC Croatia, IMC provides administrative and operational support to IMC UK and the programs on the ground, including but not limited to financial management, banking and cash management, procurement management/international procurements, and logistics.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="mso-margin-top-alt:automargin-bottom:0intext-align: justifyline-height:normal"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptfont-family:"gtThis project goal is to reduce morbidity and mortality related to infectious diseases, by provision of emergency health services to communities projected to be most affected by El Nino induced riverine flooding in Jowhar district of Middle Shabelle region of Somalia. The project will cover 6 months and targets to reach a total of 30,000 direct beneficiaries (22,200 host and 7,800 IDPs), (12,900 lt5 Years old, 17,100 gt5 years old), (10,500 male 19,500 female) and a total of 137,291 indirect beneficiaries across 12 villages/town and IDP camps namely Alla amin IDP camp, Gumbe village, Blook village, Mayungaale village, Alla Suge IDP, Bayaxaaw village, Da'ifo village, Bulowaray viallge, Dabaylay village, Airport IDP, Shamiindo village and Magadleey village with 2 Mobile health team health actions and Mahaday town and Jowhar Hantiwadag village with fixed health centre and CTC services respectively. Each Mobile team will serve 1 site, either IDP camp or riverine village per week covering a total of 10 sites over 6 working days. Mobile teams will operate from its base at Jowhar to replenish supplies and link referral cases to the Hospital and Health centers nearby, they also link with IDP sites and villages via Community Health volunteers based at IDP/village sites. The Fixed Health center will be at Mahaday town and CTC will be at Jowhar regional Hospital. The proposed activities are as follows Provision of lifesaving primary and emergency health care services including (i) Diagnosis, treatment, and necessary follow-up of common morbidities injuries (ii) Provision of reproductive health services including BEmONC ANC and PNC services and clinical management of rape intimate partner violence (CMR/IPV), (iii) Immunization to expand coverage of vaccination in children aged 5 years below and pregnant women in line with Somalia national immunization schedule, (iv) Provision of mental health/psychosocial services e.g., psychological first Aid, individual counselling, community awareness and establishment of Self-help Support Groups and referrals for more specialized care for mental health cases in need. (v) Growth monitoring and Nutritional screening for children under 5 and referral for malnourished children. IMC will also propose to strengthen referral services and linkage to secondary health services, Pre-position and provide essential and emergency medical supplies, strengthen surveillance and alert verification system at community and facility level, enhance risk communication and coordination activities, strengthen infection prevention and control (IPC) at cholera treatment and Isolation centers, and capacity building for staff and community members. IMC will partner and coordinate with other actors in the area at all stage of project life cycle to enhance convergence, complimentary and reduce duplications, this include partnering or coordinating with ARD, PAH, PDA, SRCS and other IMC sections on WASH activities, on Protection with PDA and SCRC, on Health Nutrition with Aid vision, SRCS, WARDI, PAH, PDA and SRCS and other IMC Health Nutrition sections. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt
